Pre-Processing¶

import pandas as pd
import os

# =========================
# PATHS
# =========================
dataset_path = r"E:\Arun\ddata\Data\Hybrid Intelligence in HRM Graphs\Processed_Data\Dataset\bathroom"
csv_path = r"E:\Arun\ddata\Data\Hybrid Intelligence in HRM Graphs\Processed_Data\Dataset\bathroom\interior_design_dataset.csv"
output_csv = r"E:\Arun\ddata\Data\Hybrid Intelligence in HRM Graphs\Processed_Data\Dataset\bathroom\preprocessed_dataset.csv"

# =========================
# LOAD CSV
# =========================
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

print("Original Rows:", len(df))

# =========================
# CLEAN TEXT COLUMNS
# =========================
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).lower().strip()
    return text

df['design_description'] = df['design_description'].apply(clean_text)
df['user_preference'] = df['user_preference'].apply(clean_text)

# =========================
# CLEAN LABELS
# =========================
df['style_tags'] = df['style_tags'].str.lower().str.strip()

# =========================
# PROCESS COLOR PALETTE
# =========================
def clean_palette(palette):
    if pd.isna(palette):
        return ""
    return palette.replace(" ", "").lower()

df['color_palette'] = df['color_palette'].apply(clean_palette)

# =========================
# ADD IMAGE PATHS (IMPORTANT)
# =========================
image_paths = []

for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    style = row['style_tags']

    folder = os.path.join(dataset_path, style)

    if os.path.exists(folder):
        files = os.listdir(folder)

        if len(files) > 0:
            img_file = files[idx % len(files)]  # map safely
            full_path = os.path.join(folder, img_file)
        else:
            full_path = None
    else:
        full_path = None

    image_paths.append(full_path)

df['image_path'] = image_paths

# =========================
# REMOVE INVALID ROWS
# =========================
df = df[df['image_path'].notnull()]
df = df[df['image_path'].apply(lambda x: os.path.exists(x))]

print("After cleaning:", len(df))

# =========================
# FINAL CHECK
# =========================
print("\nFinal Columns:", df.columns)
print("\nClass Distribution:")
print(df['style_tags'].value_counts())

# =========================
# SAVE PREPROCESSED CSV
# =========================
df.to_csv(output_csv, index=False)

print("\n✅ Preprocessed dataset saved at:")
print(output_csv)

Feature Extraction¶

In [6]:
import tensorflow as tf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

# =========================
# PATHS
# =========================
csv_path = "/content/drive/MyDrive/Dataset/preprocessed_dataset.csv"
dataset_base = "/content/drive/MyDrive/Dataset"

# =========================
# LOAD CSV
# =========================
df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

print("Total samples:", len(df))

# =========================
# BUILD IMAGE INDEX
# =========================
image_dict = {}

for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dataset_base):
    for file in files:
        if file.lower().endswith((".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png")):
            image_dict[file] = os.path.join(root, file)

print("Total images found:", len(image_dict))

# =========================
# FIX MAPPING (IMPORTANT)
# =========================
def map_path(row):
    style = row['style_tags']  # e.g., modern
    img_id = row['Image_id']   # e.g., 116

    filename = f"bathroom_{style}_{img_id}.jpg"

    return image_dict.get(filename, None)

df['image_path'] = df.apply(map_path, axis=1)

# =========================
# CLEAN DATA
# =========================
df = df[df['image_path'].notnull()]

print("Valid samples after mapping:", len(df))

# =========================
# STOP IF STILL EMPTY
# =========================
if len(df) == 0:
    print("\n❌ Still no matches. Debug sample:")
    print("Example expected:", f"bathroom_modern_1.jpg")
    print("Available files:", list(image_dict.keys())[:10])
    raise ValueError("Filename pattern mismatch")

# =========================
# IMAGE LOADER
# =========================
def load_image(path):
    img = tf.io.read_file(path)
    img = tf.image.decode_jpeg(img, channels=3)
    img = tf.image.resize(img, (224, 224))
    img = img / 255.0
    return img

# =========================
# TEXT PROCESSING
# =========================
text_vectorizer = tf.keras.layers.TextVectorization(
    max_tokens=10000,
    output_mode='int',
    output_sequence_length=100
)

text_vectorizer.adapt(df['design_description'])

embedding_layer = tf.keras.layers.Embedding(10000, 128)

# =========================
# MODEL
# =========================
tf.keras.backend.clear_session()

base_model = tf.keras.applications.ResNet50(
    include_top=False,
    weights='imagenet',
    input_shape=(224, 224, 3),
    pooling='avg'
)

print("EfficientNet Loaded")

# =========================
# DATASET
# =========================
dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices(
    (df['image_path'].values, df['design_description'].values)
)

def preprocess(path, text):
    return load_image(path), text_vectorizer(text)

dataset = dataset.map(preprocess).batch(32)

# =========================
# FEATURE EXTRACTION
# =========================
image_features = []
text_features = []

for imgs, txts in dataset:
    img_feat = base_model(imgs)
    txt_feat = tf.reduce_mean(embedding_layer(txts), axis=1)

    image_features.append(img_feat.numpy())
    text_features.append(txt_feat.numpy())

# =========================
# FINAL FEATURES
# =========================
image_features = np.vstack(image_features)
text_features = np.vstack(text_features)

features = np.concatenate([image_features, text_features], axis=1)

print("Feature shape:", features.shape)

In [8]:
import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# =========================
# USE FEATURES FROM STEP 3
# =========================
# Make sure these exist from previous step:
# image_features, text_features

print("Image features:", image_features.shape)
print("Text features:", text_features.shape)

# =========================
# NORMALIZATION
# =========================
img_scaler = StandardScaler()
txt_scaler = StandardScaler()

image_features = img_scaler.fit_transform(image_features)
text_features = txt_scaler.fit_transform(text_features)

# =========================
# MODEL INPUTS
# =========================
img_input = tf.keras.Input(shape=(image_features.shape[1],))
txt_input = tf.keras.Input(shape=(text_features.shape[1],))

# =========================
# PROJECTION
# =========================
img_proj = tf.keras.layers.Dense(256, activation='relu')(img_input)
txt_proj = tf.keras.layers.Dense(256, activation='relu')(txt_input)

# =========================
# FUSION
# =========================
fusion = tf.keras.layers.concatenate([img_proj, txt_proj])
fusion = tf.keras.layers.Dense(256, activation='relu')(fusion)
fusion = tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.3)(fusion)

fused_output = tf.keras.layers.Dense(128, activation='relu')(fusion)

# =========================
# MODEL
# =========================
fusion_model = tf.keras.Model(inputs=[img_input, txt_input], outputs=fused_output)

print("Fusion model ready")

# =========================
# GENERATE FEATURES
# =========================
fused_features = fusion_model.predict([image_features, text_features])

print("Fused feature shape:", fused_features.shape)

In [11]:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# =========================
# CONFIG
# =========================
IMG_SIZE = 256
NOISE_DIM = 100
COND_DIM = 128
BATCH_SIZE = 16
EPOCHS = 5

# =========================
# DUMMY DATA (REPLACE WITH REAL)
# =========================
fused_features = np.random.randn(200, COND_DIM).astype("float32")
real_images = np.random.randn(200, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3).astype("float32")

# Normalize images to [-1,1]
real_images = (real_images - 0.5) * 2

# 🔥 IMPORTANT FIX → convert to tensor ONCE
fused_features = tf.convert_to_tensor(fused_features, dtype=tf.float32)

dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((real_images, fused_features))
dataset = dataset.shuffle(1000).batch(BATCH_SIZE)

# =========================
# GENERATOR (256×256 FIXED)
# =========================
def build_generator():
    noise = layers.Input(shape=(NOISE_DIM,))
    cond = layers.Input(shape=(COND_DIM,))

    x = layers.Concatenate()([noise, cond])
    x = layers.Dense(4*4*512)(x)
    x = layers.Reshape((4,4,512))(x)
    x = layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
    x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    # 4 → 8 → 16 → 32 → 64 → 128 → 256
    for filters in [256, 128, 64, 32, 16]:
        x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(filters, 4, strides=2, padding='same')(x)
        x = layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
        x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(3, 4, strides=2, padding='same', activation='tanh')(x)

    return tf.keras.Model([noise, cond], x)

# =========================
# DISCRIMINATOR
# =========================
def build_discriminator():
    img = layers.Input(shape=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3))
    cond = layers.Input(shape=(COND_DIM,))

    c = layers.Dense(IMG_SIZE * IMG_SIZE)(cond)
    c = layers.Reshape((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 1))(c)

    x = layers.Concatenate()([img, c])

    for filters in [64, 128, 256, 512]:
        x = layers.Conv2D(filters, 4, strides=2, padding='same')(x)
        x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    x = layers.Flatten()(x)
    x = layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')(x)

    return tf.keras.Model([img, cond], x)

# =========================
# BUILD MODELS
# =========================
generator = build_generator()
discriminator = build_discriminator()

print("Models built successfully")

# =========================
# LOSS + OPTIMIZER
# =========================
loss_fn = tf.keras.losses.BinaryCrossentropy()

gen_opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(0.0002, beta_1=0.5)
disc_opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(0.0002, beta_1=0.5)

# =========================
# TRAIN STEP
# =========================
@tf.function
def train_step(images, cond):
    noise = tf.random.normal([tf.shape(images)[0], NOISE_DIM])

    with tf.GradientTape() as g_tape, tf.GradientTape() as d_tape:

        fake = generator([noise, cond], training=True)

        real_out = discriminator([images, cond], training=True)
        fake_out = discriminator([fake, cond], training=True)

        g_loss = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(fake_out), fake_out)

        d_loss_real = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(real_out), real_out)
        d_loss_fake = loss_fn(tf.zeros_like(fake_out), fake_out)
        d_loss = d_loss_real + d_loss_fake

    g_grad = g_tape.gradient(g_loss, generator.trainable_variables)
    d_grad = d_tape.gradient(d_loss, discriminator.trainable_variables)

    gen_opt.apply_gradients(zip(g_grad, generator.trainable_variables))
    disc_opt.apply_gradients(zip(d_grad, discriminator.trainable_variables))

    return g_loss, d_loss

# =========================
# TRAIN LOOP
# =========================
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    print(f"\nEpoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS}")

    for imgs, cond in dataset:
        g_loss, d_loss = train_step(imgs, cond)

    print(f"G Loss: {g_loss:.4f} | D Loss: {d_loss:.4f}")

# =========================
# GENERATE SAMPLE (FIXED)
# =========================
noise = tf.random.normal([1, NOISE_DIM])

sample = generator([noise, fused_features[:1]])  # ✅ now both tensors

print("\nGenerated image shape:", sample.shape)

# =========================
# VISUALIZE OUTPUT
# =========================
img = (sample[0] + 1) / 2  # [-1,1] → [0,1]

plt.imshow(img)
plt.axis('off')
plt.title("Generated Image")
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import tensorflow as tf
import numpy as np

# =========================
# 1) GENERATE & SHOW IMAGES
# =========================
def generate_and_plot(generator, cond_vectors, num_images=4):
    noise = tf.random.normal([num_images, NOISE_DIM])
    cond = cond_vectors[:num_images]

    generated = generator([noise, cond], training=False)

    # Convert from [-1,1] → [0,1]
    generated = (generated + 1) / 2.0

    plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))
    for i in range(num_images):
        plt.subplot(2, 2, i+1)
        plt.imshow(generated[i])
        plt.axis("off")
    plt.suptitle("Generated Interior Designs")
    plt.show()

# Call it
generate_and_plot(generator, fused_features, num_images=4)

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score
from skimage.metrics import structural_similarity as ssim
import tensorflow as tf

# =========================
# INPUTS (REQUIRED)
# =========================
# model → trained classifier
# X_test, y_test → test data
# generated_images → GAN output
# real_images → ground truth images

# =========================
# 1. TRAINING TIME (SET MANUALLY)
# =========================
training_time = 120  # seconds (replace with your actual training time)

# =========================
# 2. INFERENCE TIME
# =========================
start = time.time()
y_pred_probs = model.predict(X_test)
end = time.time()

inference_time = ((end - start) / len(X_test)) * 1000  # ms/sample

# =========================
# 3. CLASSIFICATION METRICS
# =========================
y_pred = np.argmax(y_pred_probs, axis=1)

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred) * 100
precision = precision_score(y_test, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100
recall = recall_score(y_test, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100
f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100

# =========================
# 4. SSIM
# =========================
ssim_scores = []
for i in range(min(len(real_images), len(generated_images))):
    r = real_images[i]
    g = generated_images[i]
    ssim_scores.append(ssim(r, g, channel_axis=2))

ssim_value = np.mean(ssim_scores)

# =========================
# 5. FID (SIMPLIFIED VERSION)
# =========================
def compute_fid(real, fake):
    mu1, sigma1 = real.mean(axis=0), np.cov(real.reshape(len(real), -1), rowvar=False)
    mu2, sigma2 = fake.mean(axis=0), np.cov(fake.reshape(len(fake), -1), rowvar=False)

    diff = np.sum((mu1 - mu2) ** 2)
    return diff  # simplified (not exact FID)

fid_value = compute_fid(real_images, generated_images)

# =========================
# 6. LPIPS (APPROX)
# =========================
lpips_value = np.mean(np.abs(real_images - generated_images))

# =========================
# 7. CLIP-T (SIMPLIFIED)
# =========================
clip_score = np.random.uniform(0.7, 0.95)  # placeholder (replace with real CLIP)

# =========================
# 8. FINAL TABLE
# =========================
results = pd.DataFrame({
    "Methods": ["Hi-CGAN [Proposed]"],
    "Accuracy (%)": [accuracy],
    "Precision (%)": [precision],
    "Recall (%)": [recall],
    "F1-Score (%)": [f1],
    "Training Time (secs)": [training_time],
    "Inference Time (ms)": [inference_time],
    "SSIM": [ssim_value],
    "FID": [fid_value],
    "LPIPS": [lpips_value],
    "CLIP-T": [clip_score]
})

print(results)

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# =========================
# CONFIG
# =========================
IMG_SIZE = 256
NOISE_DIM = 100
COND_DIM = 128
BATCH_SIZE = 16
EPOCHS = 200

# =========================
# DUMMY DATA (REPLACE WITH REAL)
# =========================
fused_features = np.random.randn(200, COND_DIM).astype("float32")
real_images = np.random.randn(200, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3).astype("float32")

real_images = (real_images - 0.5) * 2
fused_features = tf.convert_to_tensor(fused_features, dtype=tf.float32)

# =========================
# DATASET SPLIT
# =========================
dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((real_images, fused_features))
dataset = dataset.shuffle(1000)

train_size = int(0.8 * len(real_images))

train_ds = dataset.take(train_size).batch(BATCH_SIZE)
val_ds = dataset.skip(train_size).batch(BATCH_SIZE)

# =========================
# GENERATOR
# =========================
def build_generator():
    noise = layers.Input(shape=(NOISE_DIM,))
    cond = layers.Input(shape=(COND_DIM,))

    x = layers.Concatenate()([noise, cond])
    x = layers.Dense(4*4*512)(x)
    x = layers.Reshape((4,4,512))(x)
    x = layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
    x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    for filters in [256, 128, 64, 32, 16]:
        x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(filters, 4, strides=2, padding='same')(x)
        x = layers.BatchNormalization()(x)
        x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(3, 4, strides=2, padding='same', activation='tanh')(x)

    return tf.keras.Model([noise, cond], x)

# =========================
# DISCRIMINATOR
# =========================
def build_discriminator():
    img = layers.Input(shape=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3))
    cond = layers.Input(shape=(COND_DIM,))

    c = layers.Dense(IMG_SIZE * IMG_SIZE)(cond)
    c = layers.Reshape((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 1))(c)

    x = layers.Concatenate()([img, c])

    for filters in [64, 128, 256, 512]:
        x = layers.Conv2D(filters, 4, strides=2, padding='same')(x)
        x = layers.LeakyReLU(0.2)(x)

    x = layers.Flatten()(x)
    x = layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')(x)

    return tf.keras.Model([img, cond], x)

# =========================
# BUILD MODELS
# =========================
generator = build_generator()
discriminator = build_discriminator()

# =========================
# LOSS + OPTIMIZER
# =========================
loss_fn = tf.keras.losses.BinaryCrossentropy()

gen_opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(0.0002, beta_1=0.5)
disc_opt = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(0.0002, beta_1=0.5)

# =========================
# TRAIN STEP
# =========================
@tf.function
def train_step(images, cond):
    noise = tf.random.normal([tf.shape(images)[0], NOISE_DIM])

    with tf.GradientTape() as g_tape, tf.GradientTape() as d_tape:

        fake = generator([noise, cond], training=True)

        real_out = discriminator([images, cond], training=True)
        fake_out = discriminator([fake, cond], training=True)

        g_loss = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(fake_out), fake_out)

        d_loss_real = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(real_out), real_out)
        d_loss_fake = loss_fn(tf.zeros_like(fake_out), fake_out)
        d_loss = d_loss_real + d_loss_fake

    g_grad = g_tape.gradient(g_loss, generator.trainable_variables)
    d_grad = d_tape.gradient(d_loss, discriminator.trainable_variables)

    gen_opt.apply_gradients(zip(g_grad, generator.trainable_variables))
    disc_opt.apply_gradients(zip(d_grad, discriminator.trainable_variables))

    return g_loss, d_loss

# =========================
# VALIDATION STEP
# =========================
def validation_step(images, cond):
    noise = tf.random.normal([tf.shape(images)[0], NOISE_DIM])

    fake = generator([noise, cond], training=False)

    real_out = discriminator([images, cond], training=False)
    fake_out = discriminator([fake, cond], training=False)

    g_loss = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(fake_out), fake_out)

    d_loss_real = loss_fn(tf.ones_like(real_out), real_out)
    d_loss_fake = loss_fn(tf.zeros_like(fake_out), fake_out)
    d_loss = d_loss_real + d_loss_fake

    return g_loss, d_loss

# =========================
# TRAINING LOOP
# =========================
g_losses, d_losses = [], []
val_g_losses, val_d_losses = [], []

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    print(f"\nEpoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS}")

    g_epoch, d_epoch = [], []

    for imgs, cond in train_ds:
        g_loss, d_loss = train_step(imgs, cond)
        g_epoch.append(g_loss.numpy())
        d_epoch.append(d_loss.numpy())

    val_g_epoch, val_d_epoch = [], []

    for imgs, cond in val_ds:
        vg, vd = validation_step(imgs, cond)
        val_g_epoch.append(vg.numpy())
        val_d_epoch.append(vd.numpy())

    g_losses.append(np.mean(g_epoch))
    d_losses.append(np.mean(d_epoch))
    val_g_losses.append(np.mean(val_g_epoch))
    val_d_losses.append(np.mean(val_d_epoch))

    print(f"G Loss: {g_losses[-1]:.4f} | D Loss: {d_losses[-1]:.4f}")
    print(f"Val G: {val_g_losses[-1]:.4f} | Val D: {val_d_losses[-1]:.4f}")

# =========================
# PLOT CURVES
# =========================
epochs_range = range(1, EPOCHS+1)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
plt.plot(epochs_range, g_losses, label='Train G Loss')
plt.plot(epochs_range, val_g_losses, label='Val G Loss')
plt.plot(epochs_range, d_losses, label='Train D Loss')
plt.plot(epochs_range, val_d_losses, label='Val D Loss')

plt.xlabel("Epochs")
plt.ylabel("Loss")
plt.title("")
plt.legend()
plt.grid()
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay

def plot_confusion_matrix(model, X_test, y_test, class_names):
    """
    model        : trained Keras model
    X_test       : test features (or images)
    y_test       : true labels (integer encoded)
    class_names  : list of class labels
    """

    # Predictions
    y_pred_probs = model.predict(X_test)
    y_pred = np.argmax(y_pred_probs, axis=1)

    # Confusion matrix
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)

    # Plot
    disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=class_names)
    disp.plot(cmap='Blues', xticks_rotation=45)

    plt.title("")
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve, average_precision_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import label_binarize

def plot_precision_recall(model, X_test, y_test, num_classes):
    """
    model       : trained Keras model
    X_test      : test data
    y_test      : true labels (integer encoded OR one-hot)
    num_classes : number of classes
    """

    # Convert labels to one-hot if needed
    if len(y_test.shape) == 1:
        y_test_bin = label_binarize(y_test, classes=range(num_classes))
    else:
        y_test_bin = y_test

    # Predictions (probabilities)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    plt.figure()

    # Plot PR curve for each class
    for i in range(num_classes):
        precision, recall, _ = precision_recall_curve(y_test_bin[:, i], y_pred[:, i])
        ap_score = average_precision_score(y_test_bin[:, i], y_pred[:, i])

        plt.plot(recall, precision, label=f'Class {i} (AP = {ap_score:.2f})')

    plt.xlabel('Recall')
    plt.ylabel('Precision')
    plt.title('')
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc
from sklearn.preprocessing import label_binarize

def plot_auc_roc(model, X_test, y_test, num_classes):
    """
    model       : trained Keras model
    X_test      : test data
    y_test      : true labels (integer encoded OR one-hot)
    num_classes : number of classes
    """

    # Convert y_test to one-hot if needed
    if len(y_test.shape) == 1:
        y_test_bin = label_binarize(y_test, classes=range(num_classes))
    else:
        y_test_bin = y_test

    # Predictions
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    plt.figure()

    # Compute ROC for each class
    for i in range(num_classes):
        fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_bin[:, i], y_pred[:, i])
        roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

        plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'Class {i} (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})')

    # Random guess line
    plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle='--')

    plt.xlabel('False Positive Rate')
    plt.ylabel('True Positive Rate')
    plt.title('')
    plt.legend()
    plt.show()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import label_binarize

# =========================
# INPUT DATA
# =========================
# Replace with your real data
X = np.random.randn(500, 128)
y = np.random.randint(0, 5, 500)

NUM_CLASSES = len(np.unique(y))

# =========================
# MODEL
# =========================
def create_model(input_dim):
    model = tf.keras.Sequential([
        tf.keras.layers.Dense(256, activation='relu', input_shape=(input_dim,)),
        tf.keras.layers.Dropout(0.3),
        tf.keras.layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
        tf.keras.layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES, activation='softmax')
    ])

    model.compile(optimizer='adam',
                  loss='sparse_categorical_crossentropy',
                  metrics=['accuracy'])
    return model

# =========================
# 5-FOLD CV
# =========================
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

results = []

fold = 1

for train_idx, val_idx in skf.split(X, y):
    print(f"Fold {fold}")

    X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]
    y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]

    model = create_model(X.shape[1])
    model.fit(X_train, y_train, epochs=10, batch_size=32, verbose=0)

    # Predictions
    y_pred_probs = model.predict(X_val)
    y_pred = np.argmax(y_pred_probs, axis=1)

    # Metrics
    acc = accuracy_score(y_val, y_pred) * 100
    prec = precision_score(y_val, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100
    rec = recall_score(y_val, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100
    f1 = f1_score(y_val, y_pred, average='weighted') * 100

    # AUC (multi-class)
    y_val_bin = label_binarize(y_val, classes=range(NUM_CLASSES))
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_bin, y_pred_probs, multi_class='ovr')

    results.append([f"Fold {fold}", acc, prec, rec, f1, auc])
    fold += 1

# =========================
# CREATE DATAFRAME
# =========================
df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=[
    "Folds", "Accuracy (%)", "Precision (%)",
    "Recall (%)", "F1 Score", "AUC Score"
])

# =========================
# MEAN ± STD
# =========================
mean_row = ["Average (Mean±SD)"]

for col in df.columns[1:]:
    mean = df[col].mean()
    std = df[col].std()

    if "AUC" in col:
        mean_row.append(f"{mean:.3f} ± {std:.3f}")
    else:
        mean_row.append(f"{mean:.2f} ± {std:.2f}")

df.loc[len(df)] = mean_row

# =========================
# OUTPUT
# =========================
print(df)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from skimage.metrics import structural_similarity as ssim

# =========================
# DUMMY DATA (REPLACE WITH REAL)
# =========================
real_images = np.random.rand(100, 256, 256, 3)
generated_images = np.random.rand(100, 256, 256, 3)

y_true = np.random.randint(0, 5, 100)
y_pred = np.random.randint(0, 5, 100)

# =========================
# METRICS FUNCTIONS
# =========================
def compute_accuracy(y_true, y_pred):
    return accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred) * 100

def compute_ssim(real, fake):
    scores = []
    for r, f in zip(real, fake):
        scores.append(ssim(r, f, channel_axis=2))
    return np.mean(scores)

def compute_fid(real, fake):
    mu1, mu2 = real.mean(), fake.mean()
    return abs(mu1 - mu2) * 100  # simplified FID

# =========================
# LOSS CONFIGURATIONS
# =========================
configs = [
    ("Full Model (Hi-CGAN)", True, True, True, True),
    ("w/o Adversarial Loss", False, True, True, True),
    ("w/o Reconstruction Loss", True, False, True, True),
    ("w/o Content Loss", True, True, False, True),
    ("w/o Style Loss", True, True, True, False),
]

results = []

# =========================
# LOOP THROUGH CONFIGS
# =========================
for name, adv, recon, content, style in configs:

    print(f"\nRunning: {name}")

    # 🔥 Simulated training effect (replace with real training)
    noise = np.random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)

    acc = compute_accuracy(y_true, y_pred) * noise
    ssim_val = compute_ssim(real_images, generated_images) * noise
    fid_val = compute_fid(real_images, generated_images) / noise

    results.append([
        name,
        "✔" if adv else "✘",
        "✔" if recon else "✘",
        "✔" if content else "✘",
        "✔" if style else "✘",
        round(acc, 2),
        round(fid_val, 2),
        round(ssim_val, 3)
    ])

# =========================
# CREATE TABLE
# =========================
df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=[
    "Configuration",
    "Adversarial Loss",
    "Reconstruction Loss",
    "Content Loss",
    "Style Loss",
    "Accuracy (%)",
    "FID ↓",
    "SSIM ↑"
])

print("\n Table 11: Ablation Study:\n")
print(df)

# Save
df.to_csv("ablation_results.csv", index=False)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import ttest_rel

# =========================
# INPUT DATA (PER FOLD ACCURACIES)
# =========================
# Replace with your real 5-fold results

cgan_acc = np.array([93.8, 94.5, 94.1, 94.3, 94.2])   # Baseline (CGAN)
hicgan_acc = np.array([97.2, 97.6, 97.4, 97.8, 97.7]) # Proposed (Hi-CGAN)

# =========================
# COMPUTATIONS
# =========================
mean_cgan = np.mean(cgan_acc)
mean_hicgan = np.mean(hicgan_acc)

diff = hicgan_acc - cgan_acc
mean_diff = np.mean(diff)
std_diff = np.std(diff, ddof=1)

# Paired T-Test
t_stat, p_value = ttest_rel(hicgan_acc, cgan_acc)

# Significance
significance = "Significant" if p_value < 0.05 else "Not Significant"

# =========================
# FORMAT RESULTS
# =========================
results = pd.DataFrame({
    "Metric": ["Accuracy"],
    "Mean Accuracy CGAN (%)": [round(mean_cgan, 2)],
    "Mean Accuracy Hi-CGAN (%)": [round(mean_hicgan, 2)],
    "Mean Difference (%)": [round(mean_diff, 2)],
    "SD of Differences": [round(std_diff, 2)],
    "t-value": [round(t_stat, 2)],
    "p-value": ["<0.001" if p_value < 0.001 else round(p_value, 3)],
    "Significance": [significance]
})

# =========================
# OUTPUT
# =========================
print("\n PAIRED T-TEST RESULTS:\n")
print(results)

# Save
results.to_csv("paired_ttest_results.csv", index=False)
